in_sanskrit.name: जनार्दन
in_sanskrit.meaning: जननाथ (जननाथोऽसि तव) [God of the People/People's Lord]
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: जननाथोऽसि तव [You are the Lord of the People/God of the People]

in_marathi.name: Janardan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the People
in_marathi.long_meaning: Janardan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Janardan is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a combination of two words: ‘Jan’ which means ‘people’ and ‘Ardhan’ which means ‘lord’ or ‘ruler’. The name Janardan thus signifies ‘Lord of the People’. This name is given to a boy in the belief that he will rule over and protect his people.

The name Janardan thus signifies ‘Lord of the People’. This name is given to a boy in the belief that he will rule over and protect his people.

vedic_reference.note: Janardan is a popular name in Hinduism, and is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Janardana', which means 'God of the People' or 'Lord of the People'. It is also one of the many names of Lord Vishnu. The name is mentioned in various Hindu scriptures and mythologies, including the Mahabharata and the Bhagavad Gita.
